baseline_models.focus_anchor: Allah is named as both "my Lord" and "your Lord"; fa links that relation to worship, and hadha identifies it as a straight path.
baseline_models.mechanism: The doubled possessive places speaker and addressees under one sovereign relation. The consequential fa converts that shared relation into common submitted action, and the demonstrative identifies that action as the aligned route.

activation_trace.role: The named deity is literally the worshipped one and fixes the pronoun's sole referent.
Ownership and sovereignty make the paired my/your relation shared but asymmetrical.
Humble obedience supplies the practical consequence introduced by fa.
The road image turns the relation and command into a traversable course.
Straightness and balance qualify that course as aligned rather than merely one option.

changed_reading.before: A creed followed by an injunction and a path label.
changed_reading.after: One shared Lord relation generates one shared practice, and that practice is itself the aligned route.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence rabb -> worship -> path -> stable straightness.
baseline_models.mechanism: Rabb as gradual repair and completion joins worship's image of making a road tractable: divine cultivation enables travel, while repeated submitted practice makes the course stable and sustaining.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion supply the formative work behind shared Lordship.
Making a road submissive and traversable turns worship into repeated waymaking.
The literal road is the field on which cultivation becomes movement.
Support and constitution make straightness the condition that keeps a life-course standing.

changed_reading.before: Worship is a point command on a pre-existing road.
changed_reading.after: Worship is the cultivated, repeatedly made-traversable practice by which a life is brought into stable form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The narrative classifies Jesus through gift, divine making, and servanthood while denying divine offspring. Shared Lordship in 19:36 therefore replaces genealogy: Jesus stands with the addressees under the Lord, and worship cannot terminate in the messenger.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign Lordship supplies the common relation that displaces divine kinship.
Worship directs submission upward to the shared Lord rather than toward Jesus.
A gift bestowed without exchange frames the child's arrival as donation, not divine generation.
Assigning something a made state casts Jesus as a sign with a conferred function.
The owned servant category explicitly locates Jesus beneath Allah.
Literal offspring is the category negated immediately before shared Lordship is asserted.

structural_cues: 19:19-21 sequences gift, making, sign, mercy, and settled command.
19:20 denies human contact; 19:30 declares servanthood; 19:35 negates divine offspring immediately before 19:36.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bestowed and made status, explicit servanthood, and negated offspring; I infer that their contrast makes shared Lordship replace genealogy and redirects worship away from Jesus. A live alternative is that 19:36 is only a general monotheistic refrain.

changed_reading.before: Jesus reports a Lord shared with his audience.
changed_reading.after: Jesus includes himself among those under one Lord, closing the genealogical route to divinization and directing worship past the messenger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The demonstrative can gather Jesus's preceding self-description: servant identity unfolds into entrusted worship, kinship ethics, refusal of domination, and peace through life's thresholds. The path label then gathers an ethical-ritual biography rather than pointing only to an abstract proposition.

activation_trace.role: The road image gathers the preceding acts into one continuous course.
Moral and practical rectitude qualify the gathered life-pattern.
Servant obedience supplies the identity from which the enacted pattern begins.
A transmitted charge makes the practices entrusted rather than self-authored.
Specified ritual worship gives the path a repeated embodied practice.
Filial connection and beneficence extend worship into kinship conduct.
Coercive domination is explicitly negated, supplying a social boundary of uprightness.
Safety from harm carries the course across birth, death, and renewed life.

structural_cues: 19:30-33 forms one first-person sequence immediately before the truth claim, offspring denial, and focus verse.
The focus demonstrative follows both that sequence and the worship imperative without an explicit nominal antecedent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered self-description and an open demonstrative; I let hadha summarize the enacted sequence. It may instead point narrowly to worship or to the entire Lordship assertion.

changed_reading.before: This straight path is chiefly assent to a doctrinal statement.
changed_reading.after: This straight path is a whole servant-life: entrusted worship, material obligation, filial good, non-domination, and peace across mortal transitions.

context_deltas.mechanism: Running provision is placed below Mary, yet fruit requires her motion and the next commands coordinate taking, settling, and restraint. Straight worship becomes a channel in which divine provision and disciplined bodily response meet.

activation_trace.role: A made-traversable way lets worship absorb the ordered bodily commands as route-work.
What sustains and keeps something standing makes provision part of practical straightness.
A running current supplies the available channel of relief beneath her.
Deliberate shaking contributes the human motion that activates accessible provision.
Taking produce from its source supplies the acquisition stage of the response.
The eye's settled rest makes inward stabilization one result of the sequence.
Restraint of the tongue adds disciplined non-action to the path's bodily actions.

structural_cues: 19:24 places relief below Mary; 19:25-26 then stacks imperatives for motion, intake, settling, and silence.
Provision precedes effort in one case and follows effort in another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies current, shaking, harvest, settling, and tongue-restraint; I map their ordered cooperation onto the focus worship/path construction. They may instead exemplify mercy under distress without defining the path.

changed_reading.after: Straight path is an embodied cadence: receive what is placed, exert the commanded motion, take provision, become settled, and restrain speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: A truth claim meets verbal contest, then opinion-groups separate as each takes a different route. Against that sequence, "my Lord and your Lord" refuses factional possession and locates straightness in a common allegiance prior to party divergence.

activation_trace.role: Shared sovereignty prevents either speaker or audience from owning the Lord as a party asset.
The single road supplies the common course contrasted with proliferating party routes.
Rectitude supplies the criterion that precedes and judges factional difference.
Stable correspondence to reality supplies the truth around which dispute forms.
Sharp verbal contention converts a truth claim into social contest.
Each taking a route unlike another gives factional difference an explicit path mechanism.
A group organized around an opinion supplies the social body produced by divergence.
Separation and disjunction make the parties' between-space the outcome of rival routes.

structural_cues: 19:36 stands between disputed identity in 19:34-35 and the consequential factional split in 19:37.
The paired first- and second-person possessives cross the boundary that the parties immediately redraw.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies truth, contention, route-divergence, opinion-groups, and separation; I infer that shared pronominal Lordship functions as an anti-factional axis. Alternatively, 19:37 may report only the historical failure to accept 19:35-36.

changed_reading.before: The path is correct individual belief.
changed_reading.after: The path is common allegiance that cannot be possessed by a faction; divergence begins when parties substitute their own routes for the shared Lord relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Present wandering, final completion, inheritance, and return make straightness teleological. Ultimate reversion also sharpens shared Lordship into ownership: creatures travel with provisional holdings toward the One to whom both they and their ground return.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and sovereignty establish the terminus as the same Lord named at the route's beginning.
The road image allows correctness to be tested by destination and arrival.
Straight alignment contrasts with the explicit loss of direction that follows.
Deviation from guidance and aim supplies the negative route against which straightness is read.
Completion and closure supply the point at which route choices cease to remain open.
Leaving something outside awareness explains how travelers can miss their actual terminus.
Uncontracted reversion of possession makes human holding provisional under Lordship.
Return to a prior source supplies the route's unavoidable endpoint.

structural_cues: 19:37-40 moves from divided routes to present error, completed decision, inheritance, and universal return.
The focus begins with the Lord relation; the window ends with return to that same first-person divine pole.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wandering, completed decision, inheritance, and return; I infer that endpoint defines path-correctness and that Lordly ownership makes creatures provisional holders. The warning may instead be only a sanction following the path claim.

changed_reading.after: Straight means a course judged by its true terminus: all holdings revert and all travelers return to the Lord named at its start.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the swallowing branch of the path root through nearby food and drink. It remains anchored in the focus root and in the ordered intake/settling sequence, but the causal analogy is reader-supplied; render it as a material resonance, never as a replacement translation of sirat.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The branch range of sirat at word 7, read beside the intake commands in 19:25-26.

activation_trace.role: Passage by swallowing makes the path resonate as a channel through which provision moves inward.
Gathering food from its source supplies what can enter the bodily channel.
Eating supplies literal inward passage rather than external travel.
Drinking extends incorporation from solid provision to flowing provision.
The eye's rest supplies settledness as the sequence's inward result.

changed_reading.before: The path is only an external line to walk.
changed_reading.after: The path can resonate as incorporation: provision is gathered, passes inward, and participates in producing settledness before disciplined silence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because mustaqim morphologically foregrounds straightness, not resurrection. It remains valid as a same-root resonance immediately activated by birth, death, and being raised alive in 19:33; downstream prose should present it as a temporal echo, not an alternate lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Mustaqim at word 8, activated through the resurrection branch of its mapped root.

activation_trace.role: Resurrection and rising supply a latent standing-axis within the adjective's root inventory.
The road gives that standing-axis temporal extension as a course through thresholds.
Three repeated temporal spans segment the course into birth, death, and raising.
Loss of life supplies the central rupture through which the course must pass.
Stirring the still from rest activates the rising end of the standing-axis.
Living animation qualifies the raised state and completes the temporal passage.

changed_reading.before: Straightness is spatial alignment within present life.
changed_reading.after: Straightness can echo as continuity of orientation across birth, death, and the final rising into life.

strongest_changes: 19:19-35 turns shared Lordship into an anti-genealogical servant relation: Jesus is gifted, made, and explicitly a servant, not divine offspring.
The demonstrative can gather 19:30-33 into a lived path of worship, entrusted obligation, kinship good, non-domination, and peace.
19:34-40 makes the path socially and temporally diagnostic: common allegiance resists factional routes, and the true course is disclosed by final return.
summary.what_was_special: Focus branches made worship a cultivated way rather than a bare command; context then activated embodied cooperation, anti-factional commonality, endpoint-defined straightness, and contained material and resurrection resonances.
remaining_uncertainties: The scope of hadha can remain narrow (worship), propositional (shared Lordship), or retrospective (the enacted life-pattern).
The swallowing and resurrection branches are inspectable resonances but should not control translation.
The final return may define straightness itself or merely supply the sanction for rejecting it.
